description: The Air Defense Identification Zones a route meets (14 CFR part 99, subpart B), each as the regulation draws it: the Contiguous U.S. ADIZ (99.43, its line along the U.S.-Mexico border taken as crossed by a leg from one country to the other), Alaska's (99.45), Guam's (99.47) and Hawaii's (99.49), great circles between their points and rhumb lines along a parallel (99.41). Each point, each leg checked every 2 nm along its geodesic, the zones met in order and the Brief's one line: a flight plan filed and open (99.11), a two-way radio and a listening watch (99.9), the transponder on (99.13) and a position report before crossing (99.15), with 99.1(b)'s exceptions said. Warn, never limit: any altitude or speed is taken as meeting the zone.

points.description: The route's points in order, as the nav log's rows: a leg from each to the next.

line.description: The finding and what part 99 asks, in one line.

action.description: What part 99 asks in the first zone met, its exceptions (99.1(b)) said.

brief.description: The Brief's line for the route, once; null where it meets no ADIZ.
